one_sentence_story: When Stanford preschoolers tried to wait 15 minutes for two marshmallows, staring straight at the treat broke them in one minute while hiding it or imagining it as a 'white cloud' stretched waiting past eleven minutes — proving self-control is attention steering and trust, not brute willpower.
so_what_for_you: Stop testing your grit with uncovered marshmallows on your desk: hide tempting cues out of sight so your brain never has to fight a 60-second battle.
